Give me 5 product ideas, rank them, and recommend the strongest.” 2️⃣ BUILD THE PRODUCT “Create a practical outline for [product]. Include sections, key lessons, examples, action steps, worksheets, and templates to help [audience] achieve [result].” 3️⃣ WRITE THE CONTENT “Write section [number] for [audience] in a simple, conversational voice.
